purpose: Broad second-order carving across the repository: strengthen the World, North Programme, intelligence, information, infrastructure, finance, law, science, geography, internet, history and relational-graph layers without changing the canonical tree.
method: Expand from existing nodes and relationships. Prefer mechanisms, dates, institutions, records, dependencies, ownership, flows and evidence over isolated labels.
epistemic_rule: Historical and empirical claims require sources; project mythology and symbolic interpretations remain explicitly interpretive.

information_architecture.records: A record is a bounded evidence-bearing object with provenance, date, issuer, custody, transformation history and access status.
information_architecture.information_flow: Actor -> collection point -> database -> processing -> analyst -> institution -> recipient -> archive/public record.
information_architecture.missingness: Absence of a public record is not evidence that an event did not occur; it is a property of the observable archive.
information_architecture.versioning: Every important relationship should eventually support valid_from, valid_to, source_date, confidence and evidence_status.
information_architecture.negative_evidence: A search returning no public result should be represented as an observation about the searched corpus, not as proof of nonexistence.

intelligence_network.important_distinction: A liaison relationship, data-sharing agreement, operational partnership and command relationship are different edge types and must never be collapsed into a generic alliance edge.
intelligence_network.five_eyes: Represent the Five Eyes as an intelligence-sharing architecture rather than a single agency; retain each national service, legal basis and domain separately.
intelligence_network.european_layer: Model Europol, Eurojust, Frontex, INTERPOL relationships, national police, customs and intelligence services as overlapping but legally distinct systems.
intelligence_network.military_layer: Model geographic combatant commands, national armed forces and intelligence components separately from civilian intelligence agencies.
intelligence_network.oversight: Add parliamentary committees, inspectors general, judicial authorization, ombuds institutions, data-protection authorities and audit institutions where documented.
intelligence_network.non_operational_boundary: The repository maps public institutional structure and historical information flows; it does not provide instructions for evading surveillance, accessing restricted systems or conducting intelligence operations.

records_and_databases.fbi_anchor: The FBI states that most Bureau records are indexed in its Central Records System, while the Vault is the public electronic FOIA library. This distinction should be used as a model for separating internal records from public archives.
records_and_databases.cia_anchor: CIA historical declassification should be modeled as a release pipeline from classified records through review, redaction and public electronic reading-room publication.
records_and_databases.nsa_anchor: NSA declassification should be modeled separately from operational collection because its public archive is a filtered disclosure layer.
records_and_databases.europol_anchor: Europol's EIS and SIENA demonstrate two distinct functions: information storage/cross-checking versus secure exchange.

finance.graph_rule: Ownership, debt, revenue, cash flow, voting control and beneficial ownership are different relations.
finance.sovereign_layer: Every country record should eventually connect budget, debt, maturity structure, tax base, major expenditure categories, central bank, public companies, guarantees and contingent liabilities.
finance.company_layer: Major strategic companies should be represented through ownership chains, subsidiaries, financing, key infrastructure dependencies, procurement exposure and geographic footprint.

infrastructure.dependency_chain: resource -> generation -> conversion -> transmission -> distribution -> industrial/user demand -> maintenance -> financing -> regulation
infrastructure.north_axis_priority: For Denmark, Greenland, Canada, Iceland and northern Europe, add Arctic communications, shipping, ports, energy, undersea cables, satellite coverage, fisheries and critical-mineral dependencies.

law_and_governance.institutional_flow: legislature -> statute -> executive regulation -> administration -> enforcement -> court review -> amendment
law_and_governance.north_programme_rule: Policy proposals should be mapped to the legal authority that could actually implement them rather than treating government as one undifferentiated actor.

science_and_technology.research_chain: question -> hypothesis -> experiment/model -> dataset -> publication -> replication -> technology -> deployment -> regulation -> social effect
science_and_technology.technology_chain: fundamental science -> engineering -> prototype -> manufacturing -> deployment -> maintenance -> recycling
science_and_technology.standard_model_bridge: Keep the Standard Model as an empirical physics branch. Symbolic Potatoverse correspondences can sit beside it but must never be encoded as physical equivalence.

labour_and_demography.fiscal_link: population -> workers -> tax base -> public revenue -> services -> pensions -> health expenditure -> debt sustainability
labour_and_demography.north_axis_priority: Map aging, migration, labour shortages, Arctic settlement, skilled-worker mobility and cross-border education.

internet_information_ecology.migration_model: community -> moderation change -> migration -> new platform -> archive -> media attention -> institutional response -> migration again
internet_information_ecology.4chan: Treat as a decentralized collection of boards and cultures, not a single ideological organization.
internet_information_ecology.kiwi_farms: Treat as a distinct forum/community ecosystem with a documented history of harassment controversies and platform/deplatforming events; allegations must remain case-specific.
internet_information_ecology.reddit: Treat each subreddit/community, moderator structure and moderation policy as a potentially separate node while preserving Reddit as the platform-level parent.
internet_information_ecology.heatmap_rule: Geographic visualization should show documented event locations and uncertainty ranges, not imply geographic concentration merely from online participation.

history_and_conflict.conflict_chain: political decision -> mobilization -> financing -> logistics -> operation -> infrastructure impact -> civilian effect -> diplomatic response -> reconstruction
history_and_conflict.controversy_chain: claim -> allegation -> investigation -> evidence -> finding -> rebuttal -> unresolved questions
history_and_conflict.assassination_rule: Deaths and assassination claims require separate fields for fact of death, cause of death, official attribution, alternative attribution and evidence quality.

ownership_and_control.chain: ultimate owner -> holding company -> subsidiary -> asset -> operator -> customer -> revenue
ownership_and_control.public_private_boundary: Government ownership, government regulation, government procurement and government financing must remain separate relations.

religion_and_culture.transmission_chain: text -> interpretation -> institution -> ritual -> family -> education -> property -> media -> law -> politics -> economy
religion_and_culture.sacred_geography: Map texts, pilgrimage sites, institutions, migration routes and historical centres without collapsing theological traditions into one system.
religion_and_culture.comparative_rule: Historical influence, textual borrowing, symbolic parallel and project mythology remain separate edge types.

potatoverse.growth_chain: soil -> potato -> root -> connection -> shoot -> light -> branching -> fruit -> seed -> soil
potatoverse.system_analogy: The Potato can function as an organizing metaphor for following relationships from an apparently ordinary object into the larger system around it.
potatoverse.tree_rule: Tree of Life and Tree of Strife remain project mythology/philosophy; Qliphothic historical claims remain separated by source tradition.
potatoverse.door_rule: Door is a project-symbolic interface, not a scientific object or literal neurological mechanism.

priority_carving_targets: Expand intelligence agency records into agency -> legal authority -> database -> oversight -> historical controversy -> archive.
Expand each European North Programme country into fiscal, energy, industrial, labour, ownership and infrastructure subgraphs.
Build a company-to-asset ownership layer for strategic European infrastructure.
Build an event ledger joining dates, places, organizations, investigations and public records.
Build a platform/community migration ledger for 4chan, Kiwi Farms, Reddit and adjacent forums.
Build a hate-symbol and extremist-group evidence ledger with identity, ideology, symbol, incident and allegation separated.
Expand religious institutions into property, education, demographic, legal and financial relationships.
Expand Standard Model records into fields, representations, interactions, symmetry breaking and experimental evidence.
Expand Tree/Strife/Qliphoth research into primary-text, scholarly and later-occult layers.
Add provenance and temporal validity to relationships throughout the empirical graph.
